paper_metadata.title: A Sub-1-dB NF 2.3-kV ESD-Protected 900-MHz CMOS LNA
paper_metadata.abstract: A sub-1-dB noise figure HBM ESD-protected [ 3 kV, 2.3 kV] low noise amplifier (LNA) has been integrated in a 0.35m RF CMOS process with on-chip inductors. The sensitivity of the LNA performances to the spread of parasitics associated with package and bondwire has been attenuated by using an inductive on-chip source degeneration. At 920 MHz and 6 mW, the LNA features: noise figure dc = 8 NF = 1 dB, input return loss = 5 dB, output return loss = 8 27 dB, power gain = 13 dB, input IIP3 = 5 dBm. At 1 a power dissipation of 5 mW and 17.6 mW, a NF respectively equal to 1.2 dB and 0.85 dB is measured. The CMOS LNA takes 12 pins 66 mm2 (bondwire pads of a TQFP48 package, an area of 1 0 0 excluded) and it is the first HBM ESD-protected [ 3 kV, 2.3 kV] CMOS LNA to break the 1-dB NF barrier. Terms—CMOS LNA, high-speed ESD protection, Index low-noise amplification, NF, wireless communications. Fig. 1. Fully integrated LNA, bias circuit, and off-chip tuning inductor L .
